description: This Java source file defines the class AnnotationHashingStrategy, which extends SimpleHashingStrategyBase. It groups test classes based on specific annotations present on the test class, as indicated by the provided annotation classes. The class is used in a testing framework to categorize tests according to marker annotations.

classes.name: AnnotationHashingStrategy
classes.description: A class that groups test classes based on marker annotations for test categorization.

methods.name: AnnotationHashingStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with specific annotation classes used for grouping.

methods.name: calculateHashFromDescription
methods.description: Calculates a hash value for a test description based on the presence of specified annotations on the test class.
